prompt:
Use case ui-mockup. Generate a high fidelity UI board C · Acción primero, exactly THREE full portrait Android app screens side by side, each 393:852 aspect ratio. Preserve established Yoyos identity from attached actual screenshots: flat warm cream #F7F4EF background, white surfaces, charcoal text #242326, caramel #8C552D primary, subtle 1dp dividers, Inter semibold headings and regular body, native icons, no illustrations/metrics/photos or fake data. This is an Operate app, not a marketing page. Each screen complete with safe-area status/nav bars and 48dp controls; no cropping. Board composition differs from other options: one prominent primary action followed by simple flat links.
LEFT Inicio: business Android-QA-Zonas, Hola, Android QA at top. Pedidos heading followed by full-width caramel + Nueva venta button. Beneath it a neutral wide tappable row Ver pedidos with bag icon, right arrow and small supporting text Consulta tus ventas. Then section Tu catálogo, a mano and original helper Consulta tus productos, revisa precios y stock o agrega uno nuevo. Two compact equal-height stacked neutral flat rows: Ver productos with archive icon/arrow, Agregar producto with plus/arrow. Quiet Cerrar sesión below content. Bottom native tabs Inicio selected, archive, bag, gear.
CENTER access: heading Bienvenido a Yoyos and subtitle Gestiona tu negocio desde un solo lugar. Correo and Contraseña white fields with visible labels. Caramel Iniciar sesión button. Below a neutral Crear una cuenta button. Then thin divider and two vertically stacked quiet text actions Recuperar contraseña and Reenviar verificación. No access tabs. Fields/form is one coherent unboxed region, four actions fully visible.
RIGHT orders: small business Android-QA-Zonas caption, Pedidos heading. Full-width caramel + Nuevo button below heading. Search Buscar cliente o pedido field next. Filter row wraps into two rows: Todos selected caramel check and Por cobrar first line, Por entregar and neutral outlined icon+text Filtros second line, all 48dp minimum and 8dp gaps. Date Hoy · 8 de octubre. Two clear complete white rows visible and start of third: Público general S/ 129.90 #1003 · 1:33 a. m., payment Pagado in green badge below metadata, Entrega pendiente neutral plain text beneath payment. Second Público general S/ 60.00 #1002 · 1:14 a. m. Pago pendiente amber badge and Entrega pendiente separate line. Third #1001 S/60.00 reachable by scroll; no cropped buttons. Bottom Pedidos selected native tabs. Tradeoff intentional: larger primary-action clarity with fewer visible orders. No gradients or rounded phone bezels, render app viewports straight on.
